question: For each network status, show the status and compute the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the network MTU values, considering only networks that have an associated security binding and an RBAC entry with action = 'access_as_shared', and excluding shared networks (i.e., exclude networks whose IDs appear in NETWORKRBACS with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'). Do not return any rounded answers.

       AVG(n.mtu) AS avg_mtu,
       STDDEV(n.mtu) AS stddev_mtu
FROM networks AS n
WHERE n.id IN (SELECT network_id FROM networksecuritybindings)
  AND n.id IN (SELECT object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE action = 'access_as_shared')
  AND n.id NOT IN (SELECT object_id FROM networkrbacs WHERE action = 'access_as_shared' AND (target_tenant = '*' OR target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))

INNER JOIN networkrbacs AS nr ON n.id = nr.object_id AND nr.action = 'access_as_shared'
